criticalFindingIndependentOfMission.title: hauska-engine's vendored slate had drifted from legacy-design-tools' own slate since 2026-09-11 and was serving six stale Hays (48209) dollar-rail entries LDT deliberately removed for a live CAD-account collision — LIVE IN PRODUCTION, not theoretical
criticalFindingIndependentOfMission.detail: services/retrieval-api/src/parcel-record-slate.json was vendored once (2026-09-11, PR #417) and never touched again. legacy-design-tools' PR #671 (fix(P-177), merged 2026-09-13T18:11:15Z) removed 48209:marketValue/assessedValue/landValue/improvementValue/livingAreaSqft/yearBuilt from PARCEL_RECORD_SLATE because the record-sourced cells for these six rails in Hays predate the crosswalk protection and were live-verified serving a bare-prop_id CAD-account collision (Mesa Verde/Austin's dollar values and living area appearing on Sturgeon's own Hays vacant lots). hauska-engine's vendored copy never got this resync and still carried all six. Verified live 2026-09-13: parcel_gate_verdict for all six still reads pass/unaccounted_count=0 (a gate can't detect a bad JOIN, only LDT's manual exclusion protects against it), and the CURRENTLY-DEPLOYED revision (hauska-retrieval-api-00086-nur, created 2026-09-11T21:22:02Z — i.e. BEFORE PR #671 existed) still carries this stale slate. hauska-map's pe-record-to-facets.ts composes livingAreaSqft/yearBuilt directly from this reader with no entitlement/studio gate in the way (unlike the four dollar fields, which route through a separate cadRoll gate) — meaning Hays parcels' livingAreaSqft/yearBuilt on the live Property Explorer panel may be showing wrong-owner values RIGHT NOW.
criticalFindingIndependentOfMission.action: Fixed as part of this lane's own resync of the exact same file (services/retrieval-api/src/parcel-record-slate.json) — pure removal, strictly risk-reducing (a rail can only fall back to 'legacy', never gain a new incorrect 'record' serve). Included in hauska-engine PR #439 (already merged to origin/main, see below) alongside this lane's assigned 36-entry addition. NOT YET DEPLOYED — the fix sits in origin/main behind the same deploy-lease gate as this lane's assigned work. Given the live-customer-facing nature of this finding, recommend the planner treat the retrieval-api deploy for this PR as high priority, independent of this lane's own pacing.

findings.title: Mission step 3 (fix composeZoningSetbackOverride) is a false premise — the fix already shipped in PR #398 (lane 4). Zero commits made in hauska-map.
findings.detail: composeSetbackAxisScalar (pe-record-to-facets.ts:590-596) already gates strictly on `rail.serve === 'record'`, returning undefined (leave atom-chain value) for every other state including 'legacy-transitional'. composeZoningSetbackOverride and applyEnvelopeSetbackOverride (pe-property-atoms.ts:509-540) already apply exactly this generic per-axis override. PR #398 (merged, on origin/main at this worktree's own start commit 436a37a) already carries direct unit tests proving both branches with real Bastrop fixture values (10/30/20): 'overrides side/rear/corner from record-served cells' and 'leaves side/rear/corner untouched (legacy-transitional) when the rails are unslated, matching today's live production response'. The mission's own framing ('serves the atom-chain value for side/rear/corner even when the record carries a value') describes the CURRENT, CORRECT, gate-respecting behavior for an unslated rail, not a bug — the record cell having a value does not mean it should serve; it must be slated AND pass the gate first, which is exactly steps 1-2 of this lane.
findings.falsifierDrill: Temporarily changed line 591 from `rail.serve !== 'record'` to always-pass (removing the gate), reran pe-record-to-facets.test.ts: 1 test failed immediately with the expected diff (received the record values 10/30/20 instead of the pinned legacy-transitional expectation of only `{front_ft:30}`). Reverted via the same Edit tool call; `git diff`/`git status` confirmed the worktree is byte-identical to origin/main before and after. Proves PR #398's existing coverage is not vacuous — it is the exact regression guard this mission asked for, already in place.
findings.action: No code or test change needed in hauska-map for step 3. The actual fix is entirely steps 1+2 (slating) — once the reader reports serve:'record' for these five rails, the already-tested composer picks them up automatically. This will be verified live in step 4 (R-4 probe) once steps 1-2 deploy. Reported as a contradicted mission premise, not silently done as 'busy work' that would duplicate PR #398's own coverage.
